relationships.subject: HIF-1α
relationships.evidence_quote: HIF-1α has been shown to contribute to the survival of NP cells in the harsh, hypoxic environment by increasing gal-3 expression, thereby inhibiting Fas receptor/Fas ligand-mediated apoptosis

relationships.subject: intervertebral disc degeneration
relationships.evidence_quote: degenerative disc changes at the tissue level alter the mechanics of the entire IVD [12] and account for at least 40% of all LBP cases [23,24]

key_findings: Review integrating experimental, in silico and regenerative work on intervertebral disc regulation
HIF-1α deficiency in mice resulted in disc degeneration with reduced PG and collagen II
